issues: Covers fell by 265 (23.40%) week on week while spend per head was almost unchanged, down £0.01 (0.04%).
Sales were down £5,817.95 (20.05%) week on week and £9,809.08 (29.72%) below target; the report says this is Lakeside's last slow week.
Sales were supported by advertising and by staff talking to people locally.
Deliveroo has moved to Deliverect; on Thursday and Friday the site took £800 of Deliveroo orders with only two staff, which has now been fixed and rostered.
Delivery had a good week, though late orders on Thursday (since fixed) mean delivery reviews need work.
The latest audit was a pass and the site reports everything is back on track.

Staffing: Tom has left; Jordan has been hired for BOH; Satyaman is training in the kitchen and on placing orders; Elvis is training on the floor; Satyaman and Elvis are being trained for deliveries; Joc is training in the kitchen.
Satyaman and Elvis are being developed as supervisors to cover when kitchen manager Rio is on holiday.
Job interviews are under way for an assistant manager, and Kayleigh has been trained in the AGM role.
Weekly hygiene compliance was 100%.
The heat lamp is broken; it is logged on the new app as high priority with Ross responsible.
Pest control is complete with no clear signs and daily checks in place; fire safety is complete but equipment needs weekly and monthly checks; electrical, gas and ventilation have no issues.
Upcoming events are Halloween, Fireworks Night and Friday Night Live.

Areas for improvement: keeping work areas and the pass clean, toilet checks, Deliveroo, continuing to ask for reviews, being more productive when it is not busy, and doing closing checks and rubbish removal correctly.

B2B outreach around Lakeside included Orsett Golf Club, Mercure Thurrock Stifford Hall, Holiday Inn Express Dartford and DoubleTree Dartford Bridge; these are outreach actions, not confirmed partnerships.
Labour was brought down to 22%.
Delivery reached a record high, although the delivery radius changes caused some late prep orders; delivery prep time was 12 minutes.
A 3 star review on Saturday about salty broth was handled with BOH.
Elvis, a BOH team member with five years of experience as an operations and area manager, is being considered for the assistant manager role, alongside active searches on Talent Funnel.
The bloody gyoza Halloween special needs final allergen and plating documentation before the Halloween memo is sent out, including to Soho.

Kei Cannon flagged that the AM dashboard showed wrong figures (very low labour efficiency) for Lakeside, Soho and Shoreditch; Kaitlin Docherty said the variance reports were filled in late on Sunday night and corrected on Monday morning, and the dashboard will reload overnight.
Staff from Shoreditch or Lakeside who want extra Saturday hours can be redirected to Soho.

Region: Ziang Lin introduced a mandatory seating upsell at all sites from 13/10: staff place the drinks menu from the marketing stand in the middle of the table and immediately offer edamame, and kitchens boil a large batch of edamame in advance so it can be blanched for five seconds when ordered.
Region: Kaitlin Docherty will send daily delivery performance (red, amber, green) to the group chats every day between 10:30 and 12:00 from 14/10.

Sales were down 29% to 32% over the last couple of weeks after a 66% drop in shopping centre footfall last month, and Ka Ho noted nearby restaurants such as Nandos are down 30% to 40% too (AM Updates 14/10).
Service metrics stayed strong: weekly aggregated rating 4.98, lifetime rating 4.8, 44 five star reviews and SPH of £24 (AM Updates 14/10).
Food cost was slightly high at 30.44% without Remy on site (AM Updates 14/10).
Region: a level 8 Halloween ramen with a super spicy factory chilli paste is launching with a video; one bag per site, about a teaspoon per bowl (AM Updates 14/10).
Region: snooze out of stock items on both Deliverect and the POS, or the whole delivery order fails (AM Updates 14/10).
Region: wage revenue baseline is 21% with up to 2% leeway; drinks cost moves to management, food cost to head chefs, new OKRs due end of November (AM Updates 14/10).
Region: a temporary reserve stock buffer (about £300) was agreed for the English sites to stop stockouts (AM Updates 14/10).
